description.text: The tunnel interior is nearly black, with the

reduced to a low, dimly lit mass near the centre of the passage. A narrow rim of reflected light traces the bodywork, while a pair of headlights begins to open a pale cone through the darkness ahead. Behind the vehicle, the tunnel falls away into unbroken shadow; the rough wall ahead catches only the first hint of illumination. The passage walls are close and indistinct, their surface texture readable only where the headlights graze them. No other vehicle, light source, or landmark is visible; the darkness ahead and behind is continuous. The car gathers itself from stillness into a slow forward creep, shifting from a shadowed silhouette into a moving shape as the glow spreads across the wall and the blackness ahead starts to give way.
Near-total darkness fills the tunnel. The
sits as a dim silhouette with only a thin rim of reflected light along its body and the headlights beginning to bloom.
eases forward. The headlight glow widens across the tunnel wall ahead, while the space behind the car remains swallowed in black.

pulls forward out of the dark, its body breaking past the boundary of shadow as the tunnel mouth lightens around it. The vehicle rolls toward the viewer, the last blackness sliding off its rear. The frame brightens around the emerging car, revealing the tunnel wall and the open space ahead while the remaining shadows fall behind. The contrast opens gradually: first the leading edge of the hood, then the flank, then the rear of the car separate from the black. The tunnel mouth remains a brightening field rather than a hard-edged opening, and the car's forward motion carries it into that clearer space while the shadow retreats behind. The car crosses fully from darkness into visible light, its shape becoming clear as the surrounding passage lifts out of black, and the forward motion settles into a steady roll.
sits at the edge of shadow, its body just breaking into visibility as the tunnel mouth lightens around it.
rolls farther forward out of the remaining dark, the last blackness sliding off its rear as the frame brightens.
